content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary estimand description inconsistent with endpoint definition",
      "quote": "Primary Estimand Description: HR of PFS between AMG 510 and docetaxel, for subjects with previously treated locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with KRAS p.G12C mutation, before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary estimand description omits the intercurrent event strategy for death (which is included in the PFS endpoint as 'death from any cause') and does not specify how deaths are handled in the estimand. The endpoint definition includes death as an event, but the estimand description only mentions censoring at new anti-cancer therapy, leaving ambiguity about deaths before or after new therapy.",
      "fix": "Clarify in the estimand description that death from any cause is an event and specify the strategy for deaths that occur after start of new anti-cancer therapy (e.g., whether they are censored or counted)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary estimand for PRO has inconsistent timepoint",
      "quote": "Secondary Estimand Description - PRO: Change from baseline to Week 14 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO endpoint is defined as 'Change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12' in the objectives table, but the estimand description says 'Week 14'. This discrepancy will cause confusion in analysis and interpretation.",
      "fix": "Align the estimand description with the endpoint definition, using 'Week 12' consistently throughout."
    },
    {
      "title": "Crossover description lacks detail on timing and consent",
      "quote": "Once subjects on the docetaxel arm are determined to have radiological progression according to RECIST v1.1 by the investigator and progressive disease undergoes independent central confirmation, they will be given the opportunity to crossover and receive AMG 510.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis mentions crossover but does not specify the timing of crossover relative to confirmation, whether subjects must provide additional informed consent, or how crossover affects the estimand for OS (which is stated to be 'regardless of crossover'). This lack of detail may lead to operational ambiguity.",
      "fix": "Add a section detailing crossover procedures, including timing, consent, and impact on analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Stratification factors not fully defined",
      "quote": "Subjects will be stratified by number of prior lines of therapy in advanced disease (1 versus 2 versus > 2), race (Asian versus non-Asian), and history of central nervous system (CNS) involvement (present or absent).",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The stratification factors are listed but not defined in detail (e.g., how 'history of CNS involvement' is assessed, whether it includes treated/stable brain metastases). This could lead to inconsistent stratification at sites.",
      "fix": "Provide operational definitions for each stratification factor in the protocol body."
    },
    {
      "title": "Treatment beyond progression and crossover sections referenced but not included",
      "quote": "See Section 99.1.6 and Section 8.1.7 for AMG 510 and docetaxel treatment beyond radiologic progression. See Section 8.1.8 for crossover.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis references sections 99.1.6, 8.1.7, and 8.1.8 for treatment beyond progression and crossover, but these sections are not provided in the text. Without this content, the protocol is incomplete regarding key procedures.",
      "fix": "Include the referenced sections in the protocol or ensure they are available in the full document."
    },
    {
      "title": "End of trial definition missing",
      "quote": "All subjects remaining on study will be followed for survival, as specified in the Schedule of Activities (Section 1.3), until the pre-specified OS events are reached, regardless of the OS analysis result at the PFS primary analysis.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis does not define the end of trial (e.g., last subject last visit or date of final OS analysis). This is a required element in ICH M11 Section 4.4 and is marked as thin/missing.",
      "fix": "Add a clear statement defining the end of trial, such as 'The end of trial is the date of the last visit of the last subject or the date of the final OS analysis, whichever occurs later.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Access to trial intervention after end of trial not addressed",
      "quote": "Subjects will continue treatment until independent central confirmation of progression, intolerance of treatment leading to treatment discontinuation, initiation of another anticancer therapy or withdrawal of consent.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis does not describe post-trial access to AMG 510 for subjects who benefit from treatment after the trial ends. This is a required element in ICH M11 Section 4.5 and is marked as missing.",
      "fix": "Add a statement on post-trial access, including whether AMG 510 will be provided after the trial and under what conditions."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size determination not provided",
      "quote": "Approximately 330 previously treated subjects with locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with centrally confirmed KRAS p.G12C mutation will be enrolled and randomized 2:1 to receive either AMG 510 or docetaxel.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states the sample size but does not provide the rationale or assumptions (e.g., expected hazard ratio, power, alpha) behind the 330 subjects. This is a required element in ICH M11 Section 10.11 and is marked as missing.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size determination section detailing the assumptions, power, and calculation method."
    }
  ]
}
